console.description: Primary console interface for the Asterisk demo application.

console_dahdi.description: Alternate console interface, commented out by default. Used for DAHDI hardware console.

console_phone.description: Alternate console interface, commented out by default. Used for virtual phone devices.

trunk.description: Default trunk interface for outgoing calls.

trunkmsd.description: Maximum Seconds of Dialtone (MSD) to wait for dialtone on the trunk.

trunk_iax.description: Alternate trunk configuration using IAX2 protocol, commented out by default.
